subject: Marketplace regional mapping + retention/deletion handoff — Q&A
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplaceco.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: rajesh.k@cloudpartner.io, contracts@marketplaceco.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing — residency and retention overview

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our checklist for Marketplace listing we need a clear mapping of where customer data will live by region (AWS/GCP/Azure), how long each data class is retained, and the exact deletion handoff process back to MarketplaceCo on contract termination.

Can you share a concise matrix (region -> cloud -> data classes -> retention -> deletion SLA) and a one-page deletion playbook we can give to our security team? Also call out any differences for dedicated vs private deployments.

We're aiming to finish vendor review by 6/25 so any version by EOD 6/15 would be ideal.

Thanks,
Elena
Product Partnerships | MarketplaceCo

--
Attachment: vendor-checklist-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplaceco.com>, rajesh.k@cloudpartner.io
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — residency and retention overview

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. I've attached a draft matrix and our standard deletion playbook. High-level notes up front:

- Regional mapping: hosted API routes to the customer-selected cloud region (we currently have certified regions in AWS/us-west-2, GCP/us-central1, and Azure/eastus2 for Marketplace offers). Dedicated and Private can be pinned to customer VPC/region per contract.
- Retention: by default we retain request logs (metadata only) for 30 days; short-term cache (prefix/KV) is ephemeral per session and config; customer-managed artifacts (uploads) follow the contract-defined retention — typical options 30/90/365 days and can be adjusted.
- Deletion handoff: we provide a deletion token + async job to propagate deletion across caches and object stores, plus an audited deletion report. For Private, deletion is customer-triggered with audit export.

I've called out control-plane differences and KMS usage in the doc. Attached: residency-matrix-v2.xlsx and redwood-deletion-playbook.pdf.

Next steps: 1) Elena/MarketplaceSec to confirm the required retention windows (we can pre-authorize 30/90/365); 2) Marissa to align on legal clause wording for Marketplace listing; 3) Sergio to confirm any additional telemetry Marketplace wants in deletion reports.

I'll be available for a 30m sync — propose 6/16 10:00 PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: residency-matrix-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-deletion-playbook.pdf (PDF)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: contracts@marketplaceco.com, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplaceco.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-15T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — residency and retention overview

Elena / Contracts team —

Quick note on contract language: for Marketplace listings we recommend the following delta to standard Data Deletion clause to reduce churn across clouds: 1) define "Covered Data Classes" (Pseudonymized telemetry vs Customer Content), 2) specify deletion SLA tiers (30/90/365), and 3) include a federated deletion acknowledgement mechanism (Redwood writes a signed deletion receipt and Marketplace confirms completion).

I'll draft a short paragraph you can drop into the SOW and we can include the residency matrix as an appendix. If legal needs us to commit to region-locking (i.e., not move data outside elected cloud providers), we can accept region-locking for Hosted Marketplace offers but need a product-level exception for fallback in disaster recovery — we propose a documented escape hatch that requires 72h notice and encrypted transit.

Circling back after I have the paragraph ready (EOD 6/16).

-Marissa
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: marketplace-residency-clauses-draft.docx (draft clause stub)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplaceco.com>

Cc: rajesh.k@cloudpartner.io, contracts@marketplaceco.com
Date: 2027-06-16T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — residency and retention overview

Thanks — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from Security:

1) The deletion receipt needs to include a per-tenant UUID and a signed SHA256 hash of deleted object manifests. Is that possible?
2) For AWS/GCP/Azure differences: they want to see what encryption-at-rest keys we use (AWS KMS CMKs vs GCP KMS vs Azure Key Vault) and whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed for Marketplace offers.
3) Can you also provide a sample deletion report format? We want one we can slot into our audit pipeline.

If you can send the sample report and confirm KMS options by EOD 6/18 that keeps us on target.

Best,
Elena

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@marketplaceco.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — residency and retention overview

Elena —

Couple concrete answers from engineering/security below and a sample report attached. Apologies for the late reply — pulled several threads together.

1) Deletion receipt: we issue a per-tenant deletion UUID and include an audit manifest (object path + timestamp + SHA256). The manifest is signed with our platform signing key; we can also encrypt the manifest with a Marketplace public key on request. Attached: sample-deletion-report.json (redacted).

2) KMS options by cloud:
   - AWS: CMKs in AWS KMS. For Marketplace hosted offers we offer either Redwood-managed CMKs (default) or customer-provided CMKs (BYOK) when required by contract.
   - GCP: Cloud KMS with the same BYOK option via customer-managed keys.
   - Azure: Azure Key Vault; BYOK supported.

3) Sample report: attached. Format: top-level metadata (tenant id, deletion id, timestamp), list of manifests (path, sha256, deleted_at), and signature block. We can provide a JSON or signed PDF depending on your ingestion pipeline.

4) Deletion SLA and process: Hosted Marketplace offers: standard deletion job completes within 72 hours for metadata and 7 days for object-store content (contract tiering available). Dedicated/Private: deletion initiated by customer; Redwood provides tools and the signed manifest on request.

I've attached: sample-deletion-report.json (attachment stub) and the residency matrix we discussed. Let us know if you want the manifest signing to use your public key — if so, share the key and we will include it in the flow.

Action items:
- Elena: confirm whether Marketplace requires BYOK for MarketplaceCo-listed vendors (yes/no) by 6/22.
- Contracts: sign off on the escape-hatch language for cross-region failover.
- Neha/Marissa: confirm final residency matrix for the listing appendix.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Security & Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

--
